kind: strictly nested spatial policy selection; mapped-fault transfer proxy; NOT a leaderboard score

decision_rule.selection: for outer fold q choose argmax over the grid of the unweighted mean inner DTI over the three inner quadrants j != q (ties: first in surface, fraction, spacing order)
decision_rule.N1: nested estimate (mean outer DTI of the inner-selected policies) > frozen policy raw/3%/s4 mean outer DTI
decision_rule.N2: the inner-selected policy beats the frozen policy on >= 3 of 4 outer folds
decision_rule.N3: the inner-selected policy beats the max of the three matched null seeds (same policy) on every outer fold
decision_rule.N4_stability: the same surface is selected on >= 3 of 4 outer folds
decision_rule.adopt: change the local candidate's policy only if N1, N2, N3 and N4 all hold; otherwise keep raw/3%/s4 and report the nested estimate as its honest generalisation number
decision_rule.F1_feature_arm: separate pre-specified outer-only run with --n-channels 105 (the 17 label-free strain/seismicity/conductivity family-rank and agreement channels the shipped model does not use): adopt 105 only if its frozen-policy outer mean DTI > full88's AND it wins >= 3 of 4 outer folds
decision_rule.not_permission: a pass is still not upload permission (registration, allowance and AI disclosure are human-only)

rule.defect: the supplied band iso_grav_anom_hg is the signed east-west derivative dG/dx (Spearman 0.95 vs numerical dG/dx, ~0 vs |grad G|), not the horizontal-gradient magnitude; the entry's grav_asa (channel 25) = sqrt(hg^2+vg^2) and grav_tilt (channel 26) = atan2(vg,|hg|) therefore ignore north-south gradients
rule.G1_arm: outer-only run, frozen policy raw/3%/s4, channels 25/26 replaced by sqrt(H^2+vg^2) and atan2(vg,H) with H = s*|grad G|, s = least-squares scale of hg on numerical dG/dx (so H is in the supplied hg units); everything else identical to full88
rule.G1_adopt: correctness fix, so adopt if NON-INFERIOR: G1 outer mean >= full88 outer mean - 0.005 AND no fold worse than full88 by more than 0.01; otherwise report and keep the shipped channels
rule.G1b_arm_added_after_F1: F1 adopted the 105-channel set (0.2418 vs 0.2345, 3/4 folds), so the same fix is also measured on 105 channels: G1b = --n-channels 105 --grav-fix, compared with the F1 105-channel run under the same non-inferiority rule
